description: This file defines a Next.js API route for managing users and related setup in a platform, including creating users, teams, memberships, event types, and schedules via external API calls and database operations.

methods.name: createUserWithDefaultSchedule
methods.description: Creates a user in the database and sets up a default schedule, also calls external API to create a user in an external system.

methods.name: createTeam
methods.description: Creates a new team via external API call.

methods.name: createOrgTeamMembershipMember
methods.description: Adds a user as a team member via external API.

methods.name: createOrgMembershipAdmin
methods.description: Assigns a user as an admin in an organization via external API.

methods.name: createCollectiveEventType
methods.description: Creates a collective event type for a team via external API.

methods.name: createRoundRobinEventType
methods.description: Creates a round robin event type for a team via external API.

methods.name: createManagedEventType
methods.description: Creates a managed event type for a team via external API.

methods.name: createDefaultSchedule
methods.description: Creates a default schedule in external system using access token.
